heading: Why locals keep coming back to Ron.
quote: I take on work I'm proud to put my name on. That means I don't rush, I don't cut corners, and I answer my phone.

reasons.title: 40+ Years on the Tools
reasons.description: Four decades of hands-on trade work across central Victoria. No guesswork, no learning on your job — just deep experience applied to your project.

reasons.title: Central Victoria Local
reasons.description: Based in Taradale, in the heart of Mount Alexander Shire. I know the local suppliers, the region's older housing stock, and what these homes actually need.

reasons.title: No Subcontractor Roulette
reasons.description: When you hire Ron, you get Ron. I do the work myself so I can guarantee the quality.

reasons.title: Straight-Up Pricing
reasons.description: Detailed quotes with no hidden extras. If we hit a snag, we talk about it before I spend your money.
